summary_en: This study tests trastuzumab deruxtecan given together with durvalumab before surgery in people with stage III inflammatory breast cancer that is HER2-positive or HER2-low. Both drugs are given by IV once every 21-day cycle, for up to eight cycles, before surgery. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba trastuzumab deruxtecan junto con durvalumab antes de la cirugía en personas con cáncer de mama inflamatorio en etapa III que es HER2 positivo o HER2 bajo. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa una vez en cada ciclo de 21 días, hasta ocho ciclos, antes de la cirugía. El registro no indica un resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with stage III inflammatory breast cancer diagnosed within the past 6 months.
Tumor is HER2-positive or HER2-low, as defined in the record.
No prior systemic treatment for this inflammatory breast cancer diagnosis.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Willing to undergo two research tumor biopsies and sign informed consent.
not_for: Prior chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, radiotherapy, or surgery for this cancer.
Active or prior autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, with limited listed exceptions.
Current or past non-infectious lung inflammation (ILD/pneumonitis) needing steroids, or suspected ILD not ruled out.
QTc interval above 470 msec or other factors raising arrhythmia risk.
Active infection, including tuberculosis, or hepatitis B or C, under the rules stated in the record.
